lines.english: “—Pwah!”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ、はぁ、はふ～～……苦しかったぁ」
lines.english: “Haa, haa… Haaah… I couldn't breathe.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、僕も」
lines.english: “Yeah. Me too.”

lines.japanese: 「自分でしたくせに？」
lines.english: “Even though you're the one who did it?”

lines.japanese: 「息の仕方、忘れるくらいに……あずさ」
lines.english: “Enough to forget how to breathe… Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「はわっ！　また？　またですか？」
lines.english: “Hwah! Again? We're doing that again?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、もうちょっと」
lines.english: “Yeah. Just a little more.”

lines.japanese:
「……ちょっとと言わず、
　いくらでもどんと来いではありますが、えはは」
lines.english: “…No need to stop at a little, though. You can give me all you've got. Ehehe.”

lines.japanese:
妙に女性らしく体をくねらせるあずさ。
　正直似合ってない。けれど、気にすることもない。
lines.english: Azusa wriggled, suddenly all womanly. It didn't suit her at all. Not that it mattered.

lines.japanese: 「あずさ……」
lines.english: “Azusa…”

lines.japanese: 「ん……忍くん……」
lines.english: “Mm… Shinobu…”

lines.japanese:
優しく抱いてキスをする。
　柔らかく、柔らかく。時に、強く。
lines.english: He held her gently and kissed her. Softly, softly. At moments, fiercely.

lines.japanese:
「ん……んん……んむ、んぅ……
　ちゅっ、んん、ちゅむ、ん～んむっ……」
lines.english: “Mm… Mmm… Mmnh, ngh… Mmph, mmm, mmnnh, mmm-mmph…”

lines.japanese:
「ん、んん、んはぁ！
　はぁ、はぁ、あっふ、んん……んと、元気？」
lines.english: “Mm, mmm… Hah! Haa, haa… Ahh… So, feeling better?”

lines.japanese: 「うん？　うん、元気になってきたみたい」
lines.english: “Hm? Yeah. I think I'm getting my energy back.”

lines.japanese: 「そか、良かった。苦しそうだったし……」
lines.english: “Good. You looked like you were hurting…”

lines.japanese: 「あずさのおかげだよ」
lines.english: “Thanks to you.”

lines.japanese: 「えへへーーん」
lines.english: “Eheh-heh!”

lines.japanese:
照れつつも胸を張るあずさだ。
　忍はそんなあずさを優しく見つめる―――
その視界の端に、見慣れないものを発見した。
lines.english: Azusa puffed out her chest, embarrassed but proud. Shinobu watched her fondly—and at the edge of his vision, he spotted something unfamiliar.
“…A bicycle?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うんそう。自転車！」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. A bicycle!”

lines.japanese:
パッと顔を明るくして、自転車の元へと駆けていく。
　忍も重い腰を上げて、歩み寄った。
lines.english: Her face lit up, and she ran over to the bicycle. Shinobu dragged himself to his feet and followed.

lines.japanese:
それは２６インチタイヤの、ごく一般的な
ママさん用自転車。
lines.english: It was an utterly ordinary twenty-six-inch bicycle, the sort mothers rode for errands and groceries.

lines.japanese: いわゆるママチャリの部類に属するもの。
lines.english: A standard grocery bike, in other words.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの、これ」
lines.english: “Where did this come from?”

lines.japanese: 「もらった」
lines.english: “Somebody gave it to me.”

lines.japanese: 「誰に？」
lines.english: “Who?”

lines.japanese: 「知らない人」
lines.english: “Someone I don't know.”

lines.japanese:
「知らない人からものをもらったら
　いけませんって言わなかったっけ！？」
lines.english: “Didn't I tell you you're not supposed to take things from strangers?!”

lines.japanese:
「ついてってないんだからいいでしょ。
　それに、もらったのあたしだけじゃないし」
lines.english: “I didn't go anywhere with them, so what's the problem? Besides, I wasn't the only one who got something.”

lines.japanese:
「えーと、リ、リ、リサイクルリング？
　リサイクルサイクリングだから持って
　ってもいいって」
lines.english: “Um, what was it—re-re-recyclering? They said it was recycle cycling, so we could take whatever we wanted.”

lines.japanese: リサイクルとサイクリングがごちゃ混ぜになってる。
lines.english: She had mashed “recycling” and “cycling” together.

lines.japanese:
ともあれ、事情は察せられた。
　元より廃品を集めて作ったこの場所だ。
lines.english: Whatever the wording, he could guess what had happened. This place itself had been built out of castoffs.

lines.japanese:
この自転車も所有者のない廃品として、
来るべくしてここへ来たのかもしれない。
lines.english: Perhaps this ownerless bicycle—just one more piece of scrap— had ended up exactly where it belonged.

lines.japanese: 「……ところであずさ、自転車乗れたっけ？」
lines.english: “…By the way, Azusa, can you ride one of these?”

lines.japanese: 「乗れるよ！？　当たり前だよ！？」
lines.english: “Of course I can! Why wouldn't I?!”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前か……ふふふ」
lines.english: “Of course… Heh heh heh.”

lines.japanese:
「なにその笑い！
　もしかして忍くん、あたしのことすんごい
　子供扱いしてない！？」
lines.english: “What's with that laugh?! Shinobu, are you seriously treating me like some little kid?!”

lines.japanese: 「ふふふふふ」
lines.english: “Heh heh heh heh heh.”

lines.japanese:
「むきー！　こうなればあたしの大人っぽさを
　見せつけてやらねばなるまい！」
lines.english: “Grrr! Then I have no choice but to show you just how grown-up I am!”

lines.japanese: 「……キス以外の方法でも、ね」
lines.english: “…In ways other than kissing, too.”

lines.japanese: 「うーーりゃーー！」
lines.english: “Hiii-yah!”

lines.japanese: 「うりゃうりゃうりゃあーーっ！」
lines.english: “Hiyah, hiyah, hiiiyah!”

lines.japanese:
最初はヨタヨタしていた二人乗りも、勢いが
ついて安定し始めた。
lines.english: They wobbled at first with two people on the bicycle, but as they picked up speed, the ride began to steady.

lines.japanese:
忍は心配しすぎて、むしろ無表情に徹している。
　こういう時、無闇に声をかけるのは良くない。
lines.english: Shinobu was so worried that he kept his face perfectly blank. At a time like this, calling out recklessly would only make matters worse.

lines.japanese: 「自転車いいねー」
lines.english: “Bicycles are great!”

lines.japanese: 「お客さん、もっとしっかり掴まってないと危ないよ？」
lines.english: “Careful, passenger. Better hold on tight!”

lines.japanese: 掴まった。
lines.english: He held on.

lines.japanese:
「あうっ……
　く、くすぐったいから、変なとこ掴まないでね？」
lines.english: “Ahh… I-it tickles, so don't grab anywhere strange, okay?”

lines.japanese:
離すわけにはいかないので、人体構造上性的な
問題のおきない場所を選んで掴まった。
lines.english: He could not let go, so he selected a part of the human anatomy where contact posed no sexual complications, and held on there.

lines.japanese: 「ん～～、気持ちいい～～」
lines.english: “Mmm, this feels wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 性的な意味ではないはずだ。
lines.english: Surely she did not mean that sexually.

lines.japanese:
「夕焼けもきれいだよ、ほら！
　うんうん、絶好のリサイクル日和だね」
lines.english: “Look, the sunset's gorgeous too! Mm-hmm. Perfect recycling weather.”

lines.japanese: 「サイクリング」
lines.english: “Cycling.”

lines.japanese:
「知ってるよ、
　だからサイクリング日和だねって言ったし」
lines.english: “I know. That's why I said it was perfect cycling weather.”

lines.japanese:
サイクリング日和かどうかはともかく、清々しさ
はあるので頷いておく。
lines.english: Whether it was really cycling weather or not, the air did feel refreshing, so he let it pass with a nod.

lines.japanese:
……まだ痺れと熱さの残る肉体には、心地良い風
だった。
lines.english: …The breeze felt good against his body, still tingling and hot.

lines.japanese:
後ろに乗って、と言われた時にも逆らわなかった
理由がそこにある。
lines.english: That was why he hadn't objected when she'd told him to climb on behind her.

lines.japanese:
（しまったな、まだぼんやりする……
　意識、落ちないようにしないと）
lines.english: (Damn, I'm still out of it… I need to keep myself from passing out.)

lines.japanese: お腹に回した腕に、力を込めた。
lines.english: He tightened the arms wrapped around her stomach.

lines.japanese:
―――紅緒あずさ。
　最初からずっと一緒にいた少女。
lines.english: —Azusa Benio. The girl who had been with him from the very beginning.

lines.japanese: 「どうかした？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、なんでも……大丈夫？　疲れてない？」
lines.english: “Nothing… Are you okay? Aren't you tired?”

lines.japanese: 「全然へーき。忍くんは？　寒くない？」
lines.english: “Not even a little. What about you? Aren't you cold?”

lines.japanese: 「平気。気持ちいいよ」
lines.english: “I'm fine. It feels good.”

lines.japanese: 「そか、それじゃ、もちっとご一緒しましょう」
lines.english: “Good. Then keep me company a little longer.”
“Yeah…”

lines.japanese:
あずさにもたれかかる。
　その小さな背中が、今はとても頼もしく感じられる。
好ましく感じられる。
lines.english: He leaned against Azusa. Her small back felt so dependable to him now. And so very dear.

lines.japanese: （好き……だなぁ）
lines.english: (I really do love her…)

lines.japanese: 祈るように、あずさを抱きしめる。
lines.english: He held Azusa as though in prayer.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「……好きだよ、あずさ」
lines.english: “…I love you, Azusa.”

lines.japanese:
「え、えぇ？　なにいきなり。
　照れるー～、えはは、にゃはは、うはははは」
lines.english: “W-what? Where did that come from? You're making me blush! Ehehe, hahaha, wahahahaha!”

lines.japanese:
「もちろんあたしだって、
　その、ほら、好きに決まってるし」
lines.english: “Of course I love you too. I mean—well, obviously I do.”

lines.japanese:
「それはもうずっとずっと好きで、
　それはもうあたしが一番で、それはそれは……」
lines.english: “I've loved you forever and ever, and I'm the one who loves you most, and, and…”
“…Azusa?”

lines.japanese:
「いやいや、もちろんみんなだって忍くんのこと
　大好きだから！　ずっとずっと大好きだから！」
lines.english: “No, no, of course everyone loves you too, Shinobu! They've all loved you forever and ever!”

lines.japanese:
「あたしだけじゃないから……
　一番の、つもりではいるけど」
lines.english: “It isn't only me… Though I still think I love you most.”
“…Though?”

lines.japanese:
「んーーっ！　けどはもういい、ナシ。
　やっぱあたしが一番で！」
lines.english: “Nnnn! Forget the ‘though.’ There is no ‘though.’ I'm the one who loves you most!”

lines.japanese:
あずさにも思い悩むことがあるらしい。
　それは大人的な配慮のようでもあり、女性的な
感情の機微でもあるようにも思える。
lines.english: Apparently Azusa had worries of her own. Maybe she was being considerate, like a grown-up. Or maybe it was some subtle turn of a woman's heart.

lines.japanese:
「だから……だからっ……
　あたしがいるから……っ……」
lines.english: “Because… because… I'm here…”
“…Azusa?”

lines.japanese: 「うっ」
lines.english: “Urk.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、あああああああああああああああ」
lines.english: “Wah… Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese:
唐突にこみ上げた涙が、堰を切ってあふれ出す。
　それが心の奥からにじみ出しているものだと、
察することはできても真意は読めない。
lines.english: Tears surged up without warning and burst their banks. He could tell they had seeped from somewhere deep in her heart, but not what they meant.

lines.japanese:
「ああああ……っ……
　ひぐっ……んああああああああああああああ」
lines.english: “Aaaah… Hic… Nwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese:
言葉が失われる。
　抱きしめるしかなくなった。
lines.english: Words deserted him. All he could do was hold her.

lines.japanese: （悲しい）
lines.english: (I'm sad.)

lines.japanese: （あずさが悲しいと、僕も悲しい）
lines.english: (When Azusa is sad, I'm sad too.)

lines.japanese:
感情が伝わり、染み込んでいく。
　悲しみから逃れるために、無理にでも言葉を探す。
lines.english: He felt her emotions seep into him. Desperate to escape the sadness, he forced himself to find words.

lines.japanese: 「あずさ、大丈夫。何もこわいことはないよ」
lines.english: “Azusa, it's all right. There's nothing to be afraid of.”

lines.japanese: 果たしてそうだろうか？
lines.english: Was that really true?

lines.japanese:
人が夢見ることのない世界に、
彼らは生きている―――
lines.english: They lived in a world no one ever dreamed of—

lines.japanese: 「日曜は、約束してた映画に行こう。ね？」
lines.english: “Let's go see that movie Sunday, like we promised. Okay?”

lines.japanese: あずさがぴたりと泣きやむ。
lines.english: Azusa stopped crying at once.

lines.japanese: 「……ほんとお？」
lines.english: “…Reaaally?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、行こう。あずさと行きたいんだ」
lines.english: “Yeah. Let's go. I want to go with you.”

lines.japanese: 「……ん……約束だよ」
lines.english: “…Mm… It's a promise.”

lines.japanese: 「その時も、こうして自転車に乗せてくれる？」
lines.english: “Will you take me on the bicycle again then? Just like this?”

lines.japanese: 「……うん……ぐすん……うん！」
lines.english: “…Mm… Sniff… Mm-hmm!”

lines.japanese:
「またあたしが漕いであげる。
　この自転車でまた……ぐすっ、また！」
lines.english: “I'll pedal for you again. We'll ride this bicycle again… Sniff. Again!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、それじゃあまた乗せてもらおうかな」
lines.english: “Then I guess I'll take you up on another ride.”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ……あ、そうだ！」
lines.english: “Ehehe… Oh, I know!”

lines.japanese: 「ねぇ、この自転車に名前付けてあげようよ」
lines.english: “Hey, let's give this bicycle a name.”

lines.japanese: 「名前？　ははは、章二みたいなこと言うなあ」
lines.english: “A name? Hahaha. Now you sound like Shouji.”

lines.japanese:
「……っ……い、いいの！
　今日からこの子はあたしたちの仲間なんだから」
lines.english: “…! I-it's fine! Starting today, she's one of us.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、ねぇ？　忍くんが付けて？」
lines.english: “So… will you name her, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「いいの？　そうだな……」
lines.english: “You sure? Let's see…”

lines.japanese: 「格好いい名前希望」
lines.english: “I want something cool.”

lines.japanese: 「ママチャリなのに？」
lines.english: “For a city bike?”

lines.japanese: 「夜露死苦、的な」
lines.english: “Something like… ‘RIDE OR DIE.’”

lines.japanese: 「ますます章二的な……あ」
lines.english: “You're sounding more like Shouji by the second… Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「それじゃ、ジュニアで」
lines.english: “Then how about Junior?”

lines.japanese: 「じゅにあ？　なんで、格好良くないよ」
lines.english: “Junior? Why? That's not cool.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、２世とか」
lines.english: “How about the Second, then?”

lines.japanese:
「ジュニアよりはいいけど……
　なんか泥棒っぽくない？」
lines.english: “That's better than Junior, but… doesn't it sound kind of like a thief?”

lines.japanese: それはたぶん、３世。
lines.english: She was probably thinking of the Third.

lines.japanese: 「強きものの意思を受け継いだ２代目……２世」
lines.english: “The second generation, heir to the will of the mighty… the Second.”

lines.japanese: 「強きもの！？　どんな意思がそこに！？」
lines.english: “The mighty?! What kind of will are we talking about?!”

lines.japanese: 「それは……章二に訊こう」
lines.english: “That… we'd better ask Shouji.”

lines.japanese:
「よし、今日からこいつは２世。
　初代マスターはあずさ」
lines.english: “All right. From now on, this one's the Second. Azusa, you're its first master.”

lines.japanese: 「……うん、わかった」
lines.english: “…Okay. Got it.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ２世、そろそろ我々の秘密基地に帰ろう
　ではないか」
lines.english: “Well then, Second, I say we return to our secret base.”

lines.japanese: 「了解しましたマスター、ぎゅいーん！」
lines.english: “Understood, Master. Vroooom!”

lines.japanese: 「わ、わっ……いきなり曲がるのは危ないって」
lines.english: “W-whoa… Don't turn that sharply without warning!”

lines.japanese:
「へーきへーき。
　この子の扱いには長けてるんだから！」
lines.english: “It's fine, it's fine. I already know how to handle her!”

lines.japanese:
そして、あずさはまた力強く自転車を漕ぐ。
　涙を振り払って、笑顔と共に……
lines.english: And Azusa began pedaling hard again. Casting off her tears, smiling as she rode…

lines.japanese: マシーン号２世で駆けていく。
lines.english: Away they sped on the Machine II.
